name: Frodeparken - Oskarström
description: Frodeparken to Oskarström. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official Hallandsleden Swedish/API/GPX and Naturkartan title/linework define one current Frodeparken - Oskarström section. OSM relations, Pacer pages, Destination Halmstad and Naturkartan slug preserve old Frodeparken-Döbla/Döbla-Ryet/Ryet-Gyltige framing.

Official-source lane found the English section page appears older/shorter and ends around Almeberget/Döbla instead of describing the full Oskarström route. Swedish page/API text is fuller and current.
Official page/API display 23 km/23000 m, while GPX desc says Total: 22.3 km and computed 2D length is 22.272 km.
API geo_json matches official 536-point full S1 route, while nested line.geometry is a 369-point/6.772 km partial old-style line starting inside Frodeparken and ending before Oskarström.
Naturkartan title and linework are current Frodeparken - Oskarström, but URL/API slug remains dobla-ryet-hallandsleden.
Dricksvatten Oskarström says the public toilet/water point is temporarily closed due vandalism, while Toalett Oskarström says a public toilet with water exists by the bus stop.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Frodeparken
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; OSM corroborates nearby shelter/toilet/waste/information
facilities.description: Start/end handoff shelter in a beech grove. Official text says shelter sleeps 4-5 adults and has fireplace, firewood store and dry toilet. Fire use is at own responsibility and must follow current fire-risk rules.

facilities.name: Frodeparkens naturreservat
facilities.description: Ancient beech forest with rare species and prehistoric cultivation cairns. Länsstyrelsen says Hallandsleden passes through the reserve.

facilities.name: Odlingsspår
facilities.description: Prehistoric cultivation traces/clearance cairns along the route.

facilities.name: Kungsrör med Kung Frodes grav
facilities.description: Small grave field on a short spur; official text says the largest cairn is traditionally King Frode's grave and lies about 300 m from the trail.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Döbla
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; OSM confirms shelter/toilet
facilities.description: Scenic rest site where Döblaån divides. Official text says shelter sleeps 4-5 adults, with fireplace and dry toilet nearby. River is present but not confirmed potable water.

facilities.name: Flyttblock
facilities.description: Ice-age erratic boulder on a short detour from the trail.

facilities.name: Oskarströms tågstation
facilities.description: Krösatågen station near the route. Official text says Hallandsleden passes near the station via the railway bridge.

facilities.name: Oskarströmsmagasinen
facilities.description: Historic jute warehouses and emerging art/culture site. Website says exterior sculpture park can be viewed regardless of opening hours, while future indoor activity is pending.

facilities.name: Hållplats Oskarström Centrum
facilities.description: Central bus stop at the S1 endpoint. Official page says follow Köpmansgatan along Nissan about 700 m to reach the trail and lists buses 315/410, while GTFS/access lane found lines 316/937 for endpoint access.

facilities.name: ICA Nära Oskarström
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; OSM confirms supermarket/opening hours
facilities.description: Official grocery/resupply POI in Oskarström center near endpoint.

facilities.name: Bykokerskan
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API; OSM confirms restaurant
facilities.description: Official restaurant in Oskarström center. Official opening hours at research date: Mon-Fri 11-21, Sat-Sun 12-21.

facilities.name: Hemköp Oskarström Blåklintsvägen
facilities.description: OSM supermarket near route before Oskarström center; OSM lists daily 08:00-21:00.

facilities.name: Preem Oskarström
facilities.description: Fuel station with convenience shop near route km 20.1; OSM lists Mon-Fri 06-21, Sat-Sun 08-21.
